note: Audubon County Conservation Board's largest park, near Exira: 444 acres around 70-acre Lake Littlefield, a flood-control lake on Troublesome Creek (electric motors only), with a 400-ft swim beach, boat ramp, trails and three shelter houses. Several campground loops: the Old Campground at the entrance is shadiest and furthest from the lake; B and C hold the sites closest to it. --Claude
